### The Essential Ingredient
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-november-20-2023.html
Passage: Exodus 11:2-3
Points:
- Faithful obedience to God's instructions is the foundational theme of the Exodus account.
- The Israelites complied with God's directive to request gold and silver without yet knowing its future purpose for the tabernacle.
- Moses was highly esteemed in Egypt because he trusted God and stood firm on his own.
- When believers refuse to compromise their integrity, God can eventually turn hostility into respect.

### Read the Bible: Exodus 11:1–12:20, Luke 14, Job 29, 1 Corinthians 15
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/exodus-111-1220-luke-14-job-29-1-corinthians-15/
Passage: Exodus 11:1–12:20
Points:
- God sovereignly directed the sequence of plagues to display His power even as Pharaoh stubbornly resisted.
- Pharaoh’s refusal to listen to the warning of the impending final plague fulfilled God’s purpose to multiply His wonders.
- The Egyptians’ favorable disposition toward the Israelites was produced directly by the hand of God rather than mere circumstance.
- Secular cultural models fail to account for supernatural divine intervention in human hearts.
- God's power to change resistant minds offers hope that He can open hearts to the gospel today.
